stem: Through which, one of the following groups of countries does the Equator pass?

Therefore, option (b) is the correct answer.

stem: The latitude at which ‘Annual Range of Temperature remains minimum is –
expl: Annual temperature difference at the Equator is minimum throughout the year. Since sun rays fall almost perpendicular throughout the year, there is little temperature fluctuation throughout the year. There is no winter season in the equatorial region.

stem: Which one of the following cities is nearest to the equator?
expl: Colombo is situated at 60 55'30" North latitude, Jakarta at 60 12' South latitude, Manila at 140 35'30" North latitude and Singapore lies at 10 21' North latitude. Therefore, Singapore lies closest to the Equator (00 latitude). Singapore is situated only at a distance of 137 km from the Equator.

stem: The Equator, Tropic of Cancer and Tropic of Capricorn, all the three pass through which one of the following Continents ?
expl: The Equator, Tropic of Cancer and Tropic of Capricorn all the three pass through the African continent. The Equator and the Tropic of Capricorn pass through the South American continent.
